facts.fact: According to this third-party blog post, Replit's Starter plan is free.
facts.quote: is your entry point—and it’s totally free

facts.fact: According to this blog post, the Replit Starter plan allows creating up to three public apps.
facts.quote: You can also create up to three public apps to share with the world.

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit Core costs $20 per month when billed annually.
facts.quote: Priced at $20 per month (billed annually)

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit Core costs $25 per month when billed monthly.
facts.quote: or $25 per month

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit Core includes $25 in monthly credits for AI usage, deployments, and other cloud services.
facts.quote: It comes with $25 in monthly credits to spend on AI usage, deployments, and other cloud services

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit raised Core monthly credits from $10 to $25 in February 2025 without changing the plan price.
facts.quote: Replit bumped those credits up from $10 to $25 in February 2025 without hiking the price

facts.fact: According to this blog post, the Replit Teams plan costs $40 per user per month.
facts.quote: clocking in at $40 per user per month

facts.fact: According to this blog post, each Replit Teams user receives $40 in monthly credits.
facts.quote: Each user also gets $40 in monthly credits

facts.fact: According to this blog post, new Replit users get 10 free Agent checkpoints.
facts.quote: New users get 10 free checkpoints to play with

facts.fact: According to this blog post, the Replit Core plan's $25 in credits covers up to 100 Agent checkpoints monthly.
facts.quote: your $25 credits cover up to 100 checkpoints monthly

facts.fact: According to this blog post, the Replit Advanced Assistant costs $0.05 per edit request.
facts.quote: costing just $0.05 per edit request

facts.fact: According to this blog post, new Replit users get 20 free Advanced Assistant requests.
facts.quote: New users snag 20 free requests to start

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit usage tracking updates may lag by up to 30 minutes.
facts.quote: updates might lag by up to 30 minutes

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit Core users get 100 GiB of free outbound data transfer (egress) monthly.
facts.quote: Replit Core users get **100 GiB of free egress** monthly

facts.fact: According to this blog post, outbound data transfer overages on Replit cost $0.10 per GiB.
facts.quote: Overages are **$0.10 per GiB**

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit Autoscale deployment overages cost $1 per million Compute Units.
facts.quote: Overages cost **$1 per million Compute Units**

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit added a $1/month base fee for Autoscale and Scheduled Deployments in February 2025.
facts.quote: a new **$1/month base fee** hit in February 2025 (same goes for Scheduled Deployments)

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit Reserved VM deployments start at $10 per month.
facts.quote: Reserved VM Deployments**: Start at **$10/month**

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit Scheduled Deployments cost $0.000061 per second.
facts.quote: Run on a timer for **$0.000061/second**

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit Static Deployments are free up to 100 GiB of outbound data for Replit Core users.
facts.quote: Free up to 100 GiB of outbound data with Replit Core

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit serverless PostgreSQL database storage is capped at 10 GiB per database.
facts.quote: capped at **10 GiB per database**

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit PostgreSQL databases have a default storage footprint of 33MB even when empty.
facts.quote: with a **33MB default footprint** even if it’s empty

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit database compute is billed for hours the database is active, counting any request or the 5 minutes after the last one.
facts.quote: Charged per hour your database is active (any request or within 5 minutes of the last one)

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit Autoscale deployments bill 2 Compute Units per RAM second and 18 Compute Units per CPU second.
facts.unit: Compute Units per second (RAM and CPU)
facts.quote: 1 RAM second = 2 units, and 1 CPU second = 18 units
